name: Jonas Timmermann
headline: Member of Technical Staff at Anthropic
summary:
Tech Lead with a decade of experience building AI/ML systems across startups and large tech companies

I’ve worked on projects ranging from building the backend as one of the first engineers at a Series A startup to delivering reinforcement learning models that drove over $100M in annual business impact at a leading Silicon Valley tech company.

My interest in engineering began in high school, when my brother and I built autonomous machines that won the world’s largest robotics competition. Over the years, I’ve worked in Munich, Tokyo, Shanghai, San Francisco and New York, gaining strong hands-on experience in productionizing ML applications and the platforms that power them.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead ML Platform
positions.description:
Led development of an end-to-end ML platform for prototyping, training, serving, and evaluating hundreds of models across diverse use cases

• Designed an AI platform and built a framework for LLM performance evaluation and runtime checks
• Built a reinforcement learning platform focused on contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation; delivered models with $100M+ in annual business impact in collaboration with product teams
• Engineered and operated a Kubernetes-based model serving platform with 6-figure QPS, support for arbitrary ML libraries, minute-level retraining, and custom processing pipelines
• Developed a comprehensive online/offline model monitoring solution adopted across all production models 
• Drove team roadmap, represented MLP on company's AI council, led cross-functional initiatives, and mentored engineers to uphold technical and operational excellence

company.name: Anthropic
company.tagline: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
company.description:
We're an AI research company that builds reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. Our first product is Claude, an AI assistant for tasks at any scale.

Our research interests span multiple areas including natural language, human feedback, scaling laws, reinforcement learning, code generation, and interpretability.
